requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

2350-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Stone Calendar.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2350-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

529-3197-4068-8181.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
529-3197-4068-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5223-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-5223-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

443-2738-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

38-2173-5220-7918.description:
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying its mana cost.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

341-1090-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2020-2187.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-2187.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-2187.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2447-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

11-5940.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
11-5940.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
11-5940.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {R}{R} plus an additional {1} to choose its first mode, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Return the Favor targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Return the Favor to your hand.
Cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Return the Favor, targeting the copy of Return the Favor.
Resolve the copy of Return the Favor, creating a copy of Return the Favor targeting the copy of Return the Favor.
Repeat step 5.

4067-5116-6281-7327.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ragamuffin Raptor.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Ragamuffin Raptor that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Ragamuffin Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ragamuffin Raptor from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

628-2511-7211.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

589-5796-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-5796-6824.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
589-5796-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4936-5630-5632-6089.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
When the Clue and Detective enter the battlefield, Skyswimmer Koi and Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, drawing Moss-Pit Skeleton from your library, and then discarding it.
Resolve the Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3781-4191--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

428-1694-2736-3604.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
428-1694-2736-3604.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghyrson Starn with haste.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

864-2061-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
864-2061-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1671-2976-4019-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Simic Growth Chamber.
Simic Growth Chamber does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Simic Growth Chamber.
1671-2976-4019-5227.description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Simic Growth Chamber to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding one mana of the chosen color.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Repeat.

235-1811-2474.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand that can target a single creature and deal damage to it.
You have enough mana to pay for the instant or sorcery.
235-1811-2474.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, copying the spell for each other creature you control the spell could target, ensuring that Imodane's copy is put onto the stack first.
Resolve the first copy, dealing three times the listed amount of damage to the targeted creature.
Imodane triggers, dealing nine times the listed amount of damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining copy.

326-4236.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Clever Lumimancer triggers, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1171-1849.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-1849.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

824-3430-4289.notablePrerequisites: Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
824-3430-4289.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from target creature onto another creature.
Repeat.

152-578.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
152-578.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least four artifact cards in your hand and add at least eight {C}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Metalworker with haste.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your end step, Cogwork Assembler triggers, causing you to exile all Metalworker tokens.

43-1599-3685.notablePrerequisites: Priest of Yawgmoth does not have summoning sickness.
43-1599-3685.description:
Activate Priest of Yawgmoth by tapping and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {B}.
Spine of Ish Sah triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Paradox Engine triggers, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.
